titles.romaji: Dappi Suru Tame ni Hitsuyou na Koto: Growth Factor
titles.native: だっぴするためにひつようなこと

description:
A middle school boy, who likes to snap photos of things he fancies, and then draws pictures of them. On his usual route home, he spots the girl he likes with another boy. The balance between his delusions and reality is in constant flux.

Graduate Work 2014 by Ryosuke Oshiro, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)
